title: Verify rule catalogue and active rule-set discovery
preconditions: An isolated store contains multiple logical rules, immutable versions, lifecycle events, one active set, trusted validation and gate receipt metadata, active and archived categories, and a concurrent append fixture.
steps: Invoke rule.list with every filter and cursor boundary; append a later rule after page one; invoke rule-set.active.get for active and empty stores; inspect source-generated schemas and public errors.
expected: The high-water cursor yields deterministic non-duplicated pages; lifecycle and active membership derive from append-only authority; the active summary returns ruleSetVersionId, broadApplyAllowed, activationId, validationId, trusted gate receipt ID and fingerprint, normalization version, ordered rule-version IDs, activation epoch, lifecycle timestamps/status, and category ID/display name/lifecycle enum; empty authority is typed not-found; no private validation or description payload appears.
cleanup: Remove only the isolated data root.
